functional_semantics.triton: output[i] = x[i] + y[i] in the native dtype over n = x.numel() masked elements into a fresh empty_like(x) (impl_triton.py 13-16, 32-33).
functional_semantics.cutile: c[i] = a[i] + b[i] in the native dtype over ceil(n/tile) tiles into a fresh empty_like(x) (impl_cutile.py 24-26, 33-34).
functional_semantics.note: Both realise x + y (impl_torch.py 2) for fp16/bf16/fp32/int8; int8 inputs are generator-bounded to [-32, 32] so no wraparound occurs (tensors.py 59-62).

stages.triton: One kernel, one launch, grid = ceil(n/block) (35, 39).

precision.triton: No upcast; a single native-dtype add (16).
precision.cutile: No upcast; a single native-dtype add (26).
precision.note: Native-dtype add on both sides, identical to the reference; int8 stays exact.

preprocessing.note: Only the output allocation inside run() on both sides; no copy, cast or cached state; neither validates y against x.

mutation.triton: x, y read-only; fresh output each call (33).
mutation.cutile: x, y read-only; fresh output each call (33); tuning launches overwrite output (43), rewritten by the final launch.
mutation.note: No input mutation; idempotent; the contract forbids mutation.

hardware_dispatch.note: Single code path on both sides. Tail handling differs (Triton masks, 13-16; cuTile loads/stores without padding_mode, 24-26, relying on the swept n being a multiple of the tile), a legality detail that the contract resolves by requiring correct handling of arbitrary n.

fq_boundary.note: n is the case parameter and equals x.numel() (generator tensors.py 58-66). Both timed run() bodies allocate the output and launch one kernel that reads x and y once and writes the output once, exactly what bytes_expr counts (config.yaml 15). flops_expr = n is exact (one add per element).

review_items: The cuTile reference issues its loads and stores without a padding mode (impl_cutile.py 24-26) and is only correct because every swept n is a multiple of its tile; the contract requires correct bounds handling for arbitrary n. Decide whether the reference should be hardened to match (non-blocking: no swept case is affected).
